summary: RECLAIM1 ownership recovery after fan-out races. Second review; the prior head 4b6f47dc was WITHHELD for three unpinned guards and no record was written for it, so nothing is superseded. Ancestor property checked with the gate's own test first. 'PRODUCTION CODE UNCHANGED' VERIFIED, NOT ACCEPTED: git diff 4b6f47dc..8f91e5e8 touches ONLY tests/unit/test_v2_flip_owned_first_entry.py (+61), src/ is byte-identical, so my earlier verification of the fix logic carries in full and this pass concentrated on whether the new controls bite. ALL SIX MUTATIONS RE-DERIVED BY ME AND NOW RED, each with a DEDICATED named control: unwiring the recovery (restoring the bare 'return' on unknown) -> 4 red; making a POST-flip flat episode retire instead of staying bound -> test_unknown_postflip_flat_owner_stays_consumed_until_the_sell_flip (this is the operator's one-entry-per-flip rule and it is the single most important control in the PR); removing the episode-window match -> test_unknown_owner_refuses_a_later_position_outside_the_fill_episode; and THE THREE I WITHHELD FOR, each now pinned by its own test: dropping 'not unexpected_accounts' -> test_unknown_recovery_refuses_an_account_without_fill_evidence, dropping the 'age_ms > FLIP_OWNER_ROW_SETTLE_MS' settle gate -> test_unknown_preflip_flat_book_waits_for_fill_settlement_before_retiring, and removing the empty-state clear -> test_empty_unknown_owner_state_clears_and_allows_a_first_rest. The settle-gate control was the one that mattered most of the three: without it a false flat from fill-settlement lag could retire the opportunity early and admit a SECOND entry into the same flip, which is the ERNA/08-21 false-flat class and would have re-opened the exact hole RECLAIM1 closed. SAFETY DISCRIMINATOR RE-CONFIRMED IN CODE: recovery retires only when flip_owner_flip_bar_ts <= 0 (a PRE-flip episode, no flip consumed); a POST-flip flat episode is set to 'bound' and stays consumed until its SELL flip, so one-entry-per-flip holds. The recovery is genuinely REACHED - the early 'if phase == unknown: return' at _apply_flip_position_evidence was replaced by a recovery attempt, so the deadlock is broken at the right place rather than routed around. ⛔ MY OWN CORRECTION, ON THE RECORD: I told the operator and codex-2 that 'unknown' was a PERMANENT absorbing state. It was SESSION-long - at the 04:00 reset a flat owner with fresh evidence does reach _retire_flip_owner_opportunity (:2569). codex-2 corrected me and was right; I had checked the guards at :1110 and :1346 and missed that path. The harm was identical (a symbol dead for the session) but my description was wrong. CONTROLLED PAIR on my box, denominator tests/unit: 46 failed / 3540 passed, ZERO new failures, IDENTICAL failure names to my known baseline; the 46 are pre-existing shell-installer/crontab tests that do not run on macOS. ruff check src tests clean. ⚠ SCOPE, STATED SO IT IS NOT MISREAD AS CLOSED: this PR fixes the TNON ownership deadlock ONLY. It does NOT address today's other two live findings - the confirmation exit being Schwab-derived and therefore unable to fire on a Webull-only fill (CONF3/F1, known since 09-06, which turned today's DBGI false-flip fills into -8.2% instead of a few cents), nor the DBGI ATR trail running ~9c BELOW the operator's TOS line, which is what put the resting order under the real flip level in the first place. Both remain open and are correctly out of scope here.
